reflexion_1.code:
import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
# Robinson Crusoe Island (main island)
robinson_crusoe = ee.Geometry.Point([-78.85, -33.64]).buffer(2000)
# Santa Clara Island (smaller island to the west)
santa_clara = ee.Geometry.Point([-78.97, -33.73]).buffer(1000)

date_start = '2018-11-01'
date_end = '2018-11-30'

# 2. Data Acquisition
def maskS2clouds(image):
    qa = image.select('QA60')
    cloudBitMask = 1 << 10
    cirrusBitMask = 1 << 11
    mask = qa.bitwiseAnd(cloudBitMask).eq(0).And(
           qa.bitwiseAnd(cirrusBitMask).eq(0))
    return image.updateMask(mask)

def addNDVI(image):
    ndvi = image.normalizedDifference(['B8', 'B4']).rename('NDVI')
    return image.addBands(ndvi)

# Robinson Crusoe Island
col_robinson = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED') \
    .filterBounds(robinson_crusoe) \
    .filterDate(date_start, date_end) \
    .map(maskS2clouds) \
    .map(addNDVI)

size_robinson = col_robinson.size().getInfo()
print(f"Robinson Crusoe images: {size_robinson}")

# Santa Clara Island
col_clara = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED') \
    .filterBounds(santa_clara) \
    .filterDate(date_start, date_end) \
    .map(maskS2clouds) \
    .map(addNDVI)

size_clara = col_clara.size().getInfo()
print(f"Santa Clara images: {size_clara}")

# Check if data exists
if size_robinson == 0 or size_clara == 0:
    print("Missing data for one or both islands.")
    print("<answer>C1</answer>")
    exit()

# 3. Processing - Get median NDVI
ndvi_robinson = col_robinson.select('NDVI').median()
ndvi_clara = col_clara.select('NDVI').median()

# 4. Calculate statistics with pixel count validation
stats_robinson = ndvi_robinson.reduceRegion(
    reducer=ee.Reducer.mean().combine(ee.Reducer.count(), '', True),
    geometry=robinson_crusoe,
    scale=20,
    maxPixels=1e9
).getInfo()

stats_clara = ndvi_clara.reduceRegion(
    reducer=ee.Reducer.mean().combine(ee.Reducer.count(), '', True),
    geometry=santa_clara,
    scale=20,
    maxPixels=1e9
).getInfo()

ndvi_robinson_mean = stats_robinson.get('NDVI_mean')
count_robinson = stats_robinson.get('NDVI_count')

ndvi_clara_mean = stats_clara.get('NDVI_mean')
count_clara = stats_clara.get('NDVI_count')

print(f"Robinson Crusoe: NDVI={ndvi_robinson_mean}, Pixels={count_robinson}")
print(f"Santa Clara: NDVI={ndvi_clara_mean}, Pixels={count_clara}")

# 5. Validation & Answer
if count_robinson == 0 or count_clara == 0:
    print("No valid pixels after masking.")
    print("<answer>C2</answer>")
elif ndvi_robinson_mean is None or ndvi_clara_mean is None:
    print("Calculation returned None.")
    print("<answer>C3</answer>")
elif ndvi_robinson_mean > 1 or ndvi_robinson_mean < -1 or ndvi_clara_mean > 1 or ndvi_clara_mean < -1:
    print("Invalid NDVI values.")
    print("<answer>C3</answer>")
elif ndvi_robinson_mean > ndvi_clara_mean:
    print("Robinson Crusoe has higher greenness.")
    print("<answer>A</answer>")
else:
    print("Robinson Crusoe does NOT have higher greenness.")
    print("<answer>B</answer>")
